description: This file declares functions and includes necessary headers for managing and querying the XPU (Accelerated Processing Unit) context within the PyTorch framework. It provides interface functions to check XPU availability, obtain device properties, compute global indices, and determine peer device access.

methods.name: bool is_available()
methods.description: Checks if XPU devices are available by verifying if the device count is greater than zero.

methods.name: getCurrentDeviceProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties of the current XPU device.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Returns the properties of a specified XPU device.

methods.name: getGlobalIdxFromDevice
methods.description: Computes and returns a global index from a given device index.

methods.name: canDeviceAccessPeer
methods.description: Determines if the specified device can access its peer device.
